messages:
Alice Chen: Quick sync - vendors sent updated ETAs: H200 firmware hold (~3w on some SKUs), B200 steady, MI300 OEMs leaning late-Oct GA, Gaudi test images arrived early. We need alignment on (1) marketplace embargo staging, (2) cert lab prioritization, (3) GA vs preview SKUs. I propose staggered regional lifts 2024-10-15 -> 2024-10-29 (EMEA -> NA -> APAC). Thoughts?

Mateo Rivera: Can someone attach the vendor changelog? If H200 slips we should plan a Dedicated canary with B200 fallback. Need to check firmware gating.

Priya Kapoor: Heads-up - early adopter go-live 2024-10-20. Suggest: partner preview marketplace 10/15, public banners 10/22 to avoid premature exposure. Marketing needs embargo by Fri EOD.

Dan O'Neill: PXN lab capacity = 12 slots/week. Backlog H200=8, MI300=5, Gaudi=3. I can free 4 slots if we pause low-priority ops. Recommend prioritizing MI300 for OEM SLAs, H200 on rolling canary.

Ravi Singh: On call with vendors this afternoon. Ask: 7-day partner-preview build from NVIDIA, earlier Gaudi pods for smoke tests, and a canonical map of device IDs. I'll push for commitments and report back by 10/10.

Mateo Rivera: I'll draft a fallback matrix (H200->B200 quantized profile-x, MI300->MiGPU-lite) and recommend a 2-week fallback policy.

Alice Chen: Actions: Mateo - fallback matrix (due 10/08); Dan - lab replan + capacity sheet (due 10/09); Ravi - vendor preview ask + device ID confirm (due 10/10); Priya - hold PR calendar, tentative public list 10/22 (due 10/08). release-bot: create calendar block for Vendor Embargo Review 2024-10-11 10:00 PT.

release-bot: Created event "Vendor Embargo Review" 2024-10-11 10:00 PT. Invited: Alice Chen, Mateo Rivera, Priya Kapoor, Dan O'Neill, Ravi Singh.

Priya Kapoor: Will freeze public marketing assets until embargo confirmed.

Dan O'Neill: Posting lab sheet to #eng-infra and will tag this thread.

Ravi Singh: Will update with vendor response by EOD 2024-10-10; if no preview, MI300 heavy-run shifts to week of 10/28 and marketing updates accordingly.
